app.brandTag: One thing. Realistic. Find your way back.

regulateTip.body: Calm up top right — tap when it gets too much. Breath, senses, body. No timer.

syncNotice.pending: {{count}} sync job waiting for a connection.

app.offlineBanner: Offline — everything stays on this device. Sync and AI need the internet again.

oneThing.title: One thing
oneThing.text: In focus you only see the current task. The rest waits — on purpose. Plan less, stay realistic.

park.title: Park instead of losing
park.text: Thoughts and big projects belong in sparks or the drawer — not on today’s pile.

calm.title: Without pressure
calm.text: No points, no streaks. When it’s too much: Calm button. Open beta for now — later 7-day trial, then a subscription (even without sync).

mood.title: How do you feel today?
mood.hint: Optional. If you skip it, we assume “pretty good” — normal amount and times.
mood.nudge: Optional — otherwise we start with “pretty good”.

ok.label: So-so
ok.hint: A bit less, a bit more time

hard.label: Hard day
hard.hint: Clearly less, more time per thing

carry.title: Still open
carry.hint: From yesterday — pick and bring along (as capacity allows).
carry.hintShort: From yesterday. One tip: bring along and start right away.
carry.adoptTip: On your plan. Check under “Plan a little more”, then “Start day” — or start above.

work.title: Work
work.hint: Pick a size — the timer follows.
work.hintShort: Pick a size first (Small / Medium / Large), then the title. For existing tasks: tap S · M · L.

life.title: Life
life.hint: Doesn’t count toward work points. × on a suggestion hides it — your own stay saved.
life.hintShort: Can wait. Or suggest 1–2 usual life anchors.

plan.startDayEmptyHint: You can go back and add something — or pick one thing later.
plan.roundLabel: Round {{round}} — a small set, not the whole drawer.

anker.title: Drawer connected.
anker.body: Same data, two apps. The full drawer intro runs there — not again here.

schublade.title: Tagesanker is optional.
schublade.body: Switch above for one-thing focus. Same data. The Tagesanker intro only there.

drawer.title: The drawer
drawer.appTag: Park & prepare — own app, shared data
drawer.appBridgeHint: Tagesanker and the drawer share sync and local state. Two entries, one care place.
drawer.bridgeEnabledFlash: The drawer is now linked in Tagesanker too — same state on both sides.

alone.title: Its own app
alone.text: The drawer works on its own — without Tagesanker. Park projects, break them down, pull doable steps onto today. Tagesanker is optional if you want one-thing focus.

park.title: Park it
park.text: What isn’t for right now: drop it quickly — safe, not gone. The spark button below also parks thoughts without mixing them into the drawer.

chop.title: Break it down
chop.text: Split big inbox items into small, doable steps. Manual always. Optional AI (Settings) — limited in beta/trial, more with a Schublade plan.

ready.title: Ready to pull
ready.text: Only doable steps sit ready. There’s a cap so no mountain grows. Too many? Pull one or put something to rest.

today.title: Up now
today.text: At the top you see what’s already on today’s plan — complete it here. Pull a step from “ready” when there’s room. Without Tagesanker, the day still shows here.

calmSparks.title: Calm & more
calmSparks.text: Top right: Calm — breath, senses, body, no timer. Under Settings: advanced shelves (snooze, rest), AI, ready cap, install as app.

syncSettings.title: Sync & settings
syncSettings.text: Sync is optional — multiple devices, encrypted. After beta the app always needs a trial (with payment details) then a plan, even local-only. Restart this intro anytime in Settings.

drawer.dropLead: Park it and done. Break-down and more care live in the drawer app.
drawer.pullLead: Pull one doable step onto today’s plan — capacity stays in view.
drawer.pullEmpty: Nothing ready to pull yet. Drop and break down first — in the drawer app.
drawer.pullCapFull: Today’s plan is already full enough. Finish something or make room first.
drawer.dropInboxHint: {{count}} already in the inbox — continue there.
drawer.lead: Everything not for right now — safe, not gone. Only small, doable steps onto the day.
drawer.leadSimple: Drop. Break down. Pull one step onto today.
drawer.leadShort: Drop. Break down. Pull one step.
drawer.capBlocked: Enough ready to pull — pull one step or put something to rest first.
drawer.todayLead: Pulled or set for today — check off here without Tagesanker.
drawer.todayEmptyHint: Use “Pull” or “Done” to work even without Tagesanker.
drawer.restedFlash: Put {{n}} to rest — the list is clearer again.
drawer.choppedFlash: Broken down — the steps are under “Ready to pull”.
drawer.choppedMovedFlash: “{{title}}” is broken down and left the inbox. Steps are under “Ready to pull”.
drawer.energyHint: Tap energy: Mini → Normal → Focus. Matches today’s mood when pulling.
drawer.sparkParked: Spark parked — safe, without mixing into the drawer list.
drawer.pullAheadHint: This was meant for later — pull it ahead anyway?

emptyLevelBy.inbox: Drop something above — then break it down or pull.
emptyLevelBy.ready: Doable steps land here after breaking down. Pulling one is often enough.
emptyLevelBy.defer: Snoozed items return on the date — nothing is gone.
emptyLevelBy.frozen: At rest: visible only when you look on purpose.

drawer.chunkEmptyChildren: No steps yet — break it down first.
drawer.chopHint: One step per line. Every split: 3–5 doable steps that cover the full work. Finer work: break individual steps later.
drawer.chopAgainHint: One step per line. Again 3–5 doable substeps that fully cover this step (~5–25 min).
drawer.chopSteerTooFine: Too finely split — the buddy is right. Use doable steps of a few minutes.
drawer.chopSteerTooMany: Too many parts (max {{max}}). Merge into 3–5 — don’t drop work, combine steps.
drawer.chopSteerTooFew: Too few parts (min {{min}}). The split must cover the work completely.
drawer.chopPlaceholder:
Get folder
Type numbers
Send mail
drawer.chopAiOffline: AI suggestions need the internet. You can still type steps offline.
drawer.chopAiQuotaHintFree: Without a plan (beta/trial): today {{dayLeft}}/{{dayLimit}}, month {{monthLeft}}/{{monthLimit}} · balance {{wallet}}. Further splits count. Manual always works.
drawer.chopAiQuotaHintWallet: Subscription/pack balance: {{wallet}}. Further splits count. Manual always works.
drawer.chopAiLimitReached: AI allowance used up (beta/trial or balance). Top up below — or type the steps yourself.
drawer.chopAiPackLead: Buy an AI pack (one-time). Subscriptions already include calls.
drawer.chopAiPackSettingsLead: Extra AI suggestions — larger packs cost less per call.
drawer.chopAiPackNeedLogin: Sign in under Sync to buy (same account on all devices).
drawer.chopAiPackSoon: Top-up is ready, checkout not public yet — soon.
drawer.chopAiPackError: Checkout failed. Try again in a moment.
drawer.chopAiOptInHint: AI help is off. Turn it on in Settings — or type the steps yourself.

chopAiError.generic: Suggestion failed — type steps yourself or try later.
chopAiError.not_configured: AI is not set up on the server yet — please break down manually.
chopAiError.invalid_title: Title too short for a suggestion.
chopAiError.bad_ai_response: AI reply was unusable — edit manually or try again.
chopAiError.too_many_bites: AI wanted too many parts. Try again — goal is 3–5 that cover everything.
chopAiError.ai_failed: AI unavailable right now — manual or later.
chopAiError.daily_limit: AI allowance used up — top up or split manually.

drawer.deleteChainWarn: This belongs to a project or has steps. Really remove?
drawer.deleteItemWarn: Remove “{{title}}”? Only if it’s done or no longer needed.
drawer.deleteProjectWarn: Remove “{{title}}” entirely? That also removes {{count}} related steps.
drawer.trashItemWarn: Move “{{title}}” to the trash? You can restore it there.
drawer.trashProjectWarn: Move “{{title}}” to the trash? That also moves {{count}} steps — restorable until you empty the trash.
drawer.trashedProjectFlash: “{{title}}” and {{count}} steps are in the trash.
drawer.trashLead: Removed items live here. Restore anytime — gone for good only when you empty the trash.
drawer.trashEmptyWarn: Really empty the trash? Everything in it will be gone for good.
drawer.deadlineEmergencyHint: Pull to today or break into steps first. Nothing is silently pushed onto the plan overnight.
drawer.deadlineEmergencyChop: Still too big — break it down, then pull the next step.
drawer.deadlineRadarHint: Due in the next days — plan or break down, without constant panic.
drawer.snoozeHint: Hidden until the date — not deleted.
drawer.waitingOnHint: Ball in someone else’s court — short note.
drawer.staleLead: This has been sitting here a while. Still need it — or shall we put it away together?
drawer.staleChainHint: Part of a project — “Put to rest” is often better than deleting one step.
drawer.staleDiscardWarn: Move to trash? Restorable until you empty it.
drawer.staleDiscardChainWarn: Part of a project — move to trash? Related steps come along and stay restorable.

settings.shellHint: Short version here — the full set is on the morning plan under Settings.
settings.shortMorningHint: Off = previous full plan view. You can switch back anytime.
settings.drawerEnabledHint: Shows the switch to the drawer. Visiting the drawer turns this on automatically.
settings.drawerAdvancedHint: Snooze, rest, and “Coming up”. Off = drop, inbox, ready to pull only.
settings.drawerAiChopHint: When on: title goes to our AI server. Without a plan (beta/trial): 10/day, max 50/month. Schublade/Bundle plans include extra calls; top-up available. Manual always. Default: off.
settings.drawerReadyCapHint: At most this many doable steps under “Ready to pull” (15–40). When full: pull or rest first.

capacity.intro: Baseline without mood. The day question scales from this.
capacity.lifeMaxHint: At most {{max}}. Less is often better.

reminders.saveFirstHint: On your phone, add to the home screen first — then reminders work more reliably.
reminders.iosInstallFirst: On iPhone: first add via Safari “Add to Home Screen”, then allow reminders here. In a normal Safari tab it often won’t work.
reminders.bestEffortHint: Reminders work best if the app was opened today and not force-quit. Without a push server, deep sleep won’t wake it.
reminders.testBody: Good — notifications work on this device.
reminders.blockedHint: Notifications are blocked. Allow them for Tagesanker in your phone settings.
reminders.notifGranted: Reminders on. Check-ins appear when the app is in the background.

softFreeze.label: Soft freeze
softFreeze.pauseOnLeave: Reminders when the app is in the background
softFreeze.hint: The timer keeps running (work often happens on other pages). Default: at most one gentle nudge — not locking you in.

sparks.mailInvalid: Please enter a valid address — otherwise expired ideas are only deleted.
sparks.mailSet: When you open the app: ideas older than 7 days go here, then delete.
sparks.mailEmpty: Empty = delete after 7 days with no email.

help.introButton: Intro button on the start screen

paywall.tagesankerBody: After open beta: 7-day trial, then a Tagesanker or Bundle plan — even local-only, without sync. No free tier.
paywall.schubladeBody: After open beta: 7-day trial, then a Schublade or Bundle plan — even local-only, without sync. No free tier.
paywall.needSignIn: Sign in first to unlock trial and subscription.
paywall.signInSheetHint: Email and code from the mail. Backup and device sync are under Settings.

portal.error: Billing portal isn’t available right now. Try again later.
portal.none: No subscription on this account yet — manage appears after purchase.

backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.hint: As a Markdown file on this device: today, Schublade, and sparks. Independent of sync — useful before deleting or switching devices.
backup.importConfirm: Load backup and replace local data? (day, Schublade, sparks, matching settings)
backup.importOk: Backup loaded: {{tasks}} tasks, {{drawer}} in Schublade, {{sparks}} sparks.
backup.importInvalid: Not a valid Tagesanker backup (data block missing or damaged).
backup.importEmpty: Nothing useful to restore in that backup.

privacy.deleteCloudHint: Deletes your sync account, encrypted cloud copy, subscription records, and AI credit balance. Active subscriptions end. Stripe may keep invoices where the law requires. Data on this device is cleared too.
privacy.deleteCloudConfirm: Really delete your account and cloud data permanently? Subscriptions end. This cannot be undone.
privacy.deleteLocalHint: Removes plans and settings here only. Your cloud account stays until you delete it above.
privacy.deleteLocalConfirm: Really clear local data on this device?
privacy.deleteError: Deletion failed. Try again later or email info@tagesanker.de.

sync.title: Device sync
sync.notConfigured: Sync isn’t configured in this build yet (Supabase env missing).
sync.hint: Optional for multiple devices. After beta the app always needs a trial/plan — even local-only. With sync: end-to-end encrypted; Tagesanker cannot read it.
sync.loginHint: Sign in with email and code — for trial and subscription. Device sync can be set up later in Settings.
sync.sendNewCode: Send a new code by email
sync.bothNeeded: Both needed: email address + code. No new send if the email is already there.
sync.gateNeedEmail: Enter your email above first — then “Sign in with code” becomes active.
sync.gateNeedOtp: Code: enter the 6 digits from the email.
sync.noticeNeedEmailFirst: Please enter your email address first (not the code).
sync.noticeNeedEmailForOtp: Still enter the email above (same address as in the mail) — the code alone isn’t enough.
sync.noticeCodeSent: Email from Tagesanker (Resend) on the way — subject with sync code. Type only the 6 digits here.
sync.noticeSignedOut: Signed out. Data stays on this device; sync paused.

explain.show: What does this mean? Short explainer
explain.intro: In plain words — only if you want sync:
explain.syncText: Two devices (e.g. phone and tablet) share the same day state.
explain.mailText: Six digits by email — only to sign in. Not your sync password.
explain.vaultText: Protected storage for your cloud copy. Readable only with your password — Tagesanker cannot read it either.
explain.passText: Your key to the vault. Best saved in a password manager.
explain.recoveryText: Backup if you lose the password. Keep it somewhere safe.
explain.outro: Without sync, data stays on this device only — after beta the app still needs a trial/plan.

conflict.body: Cloud and this device both changed — e.g. offline here and in parallel elsewhere. Keep which? (No automatic merge.)

sync.offlineHint: You’re offline — sync is paused. Changes stay here and sync when you’re back online (or you choose if there’s a conflict).

errors.sendFailed: Couldn’t send the code. Try again in a moment.
errors.mailDomain: Email sending isn’t enabled yet (sender domain). Try later — or tell the operator.
errors.needSixDigit: Please enter the 6-digit code from the email.
errors.payloadTooLarge: Sync failed — data too large (e.g. audio/sketches).
errors.noCode: No code pending — send a new code by email first.
errors.codeExpired: Code expired. Please send a new one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please send a new code.
errors.sessionFailed: Sign-in failed after the code check.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
errors.vaultLocked: Sync vault locked — enter password or emergency code.
errors.vaultSetupRequired: Please set a sync password first.
errors.legacyBlocked: Old unencrypted cloud data — please set up the sync vault again (keep local data).
errors.rateLimited: Too many codes requested. Wait a moment, then try again.

vault.trust: Only you can read the contents — not Tagesanker. Without sync, everything stays local as before.
vault.setupHint: Protects your cloud copy (including sparks). Not the email code. Saving in your phone’s password manager is recommended.
vault.unlockHint: Per browser session. After reloading the app, enter it again — the key is not stored.
vault.restoreLocalHint: Data is still here: set a new password and overwrite the cloud. Other devices will need the new password.
vault.recoveryOnce: Keep this code. It brings sync back if you lose the password.
vault.noticeSetupOk: Vault created. Please save the emergency code.
vault.noticeRecoveryRotated: Vault unlocked — new emergency code (old one invalid). Please save it.
vault.noticeMailed: Mail app opened — key does not go through Tagesanker.
vault.noticeRegen: New emergency code — please save it again.

pwa.installed: Good: {{name}} is installed as an app on this device. Reminders work best this way.
pwa.title: {{name}} on your phone
pwa.lead: In short: add {{name}} to the home screen once. Then open it like a normal app — and allow notifications. Tagesanker and the drawer can be installed separately.

ios.title: iPhone
ios.step1: Tap Share at the bottom (square with arrow).
ios.step2: Scroll down → Add to Home Screen.
ios.step4: Open {{name}} from the home screen (not via Safari).
ios.note: Tip: On iPhone this only works in Safari — not Chrome.

android.title: Android
android.step1: Tap the three dots at the top right.
android.step2: Choose Install app or Add to Home screen.

pwa.foot: Done. You don’t need an app store — just save this page once.

feierabend.title: Feierabend mode
feierabend.lineWithLife: Work done · sparks unlocked · {{count}} life left

focus.noActive: No active task left. You can end the day or pick something still open.
focus.noActiveEmpty: No task yet — that’s fine. End the day, or go back and add one.

afterRegulate.warm: Welcome back. The timer was paused. No pressure — continue when you’re ready.
afterRegulate.klar: Returned. Timer paused — resume when ready.

notify.feierabendBodyLife: Work done. Sparks unlocked — life left.
notify.sleepBody: Going to bed on time is still open.

done.roundDone: You finished what you set for this round. Nice.
done.roundChoiceHint: Call it a day closes the day. Another round = plan again (mood again).
done.empty: Nothing checked off yet — okay for today.

regulate.buttonAria: Calm: regulate down when it gets too much
regulate.buttonTitle: When it gets too much — tap here
regulate.title: Just breathe. Nothing to perform.
regulate.lead: Timer and tasks are hidden. You can return anytime — no judgment.

breathe.hint: Follow the circle — as well as you can right now. Imperfect is enough.

senses.hint: Out loud or just in your head. No need to write.

prompts.see5: Name 5 things around you that you can see.
prompts.smell2: Name 2 things you can smell — or imagine.
prompts.taste1: Name 1 thing you can taste — or take a sip of water.

body.hint: The bare minimum — tap what you’re doing or already did.

ice.title: Cool on the face
ice.text: Cold water, a cool cloth, or briefly at an open window.

chest.title: Hand on chest
chest.text: Press lightly. Feel that you’re here.

audio.idle: Max. {{max}} seconds — then back to the task.
audio.unsupported: Audio recording isn’t available in this browser.
audio.noRecording: No recording — record briefly, then park.

sparkVault.title: Spark vault
sparkVault.unlocked: Work tasks done — now you may browse.
sparkVault.retain: Ideas stay at most 7 days. With an email in Settings they’re sent first, then deleted. Otherwise quietly removed when you open the app again.
sparkVault.waitingOne: {{count}} idea waiting here. Life doesn’t unlock this.
sparkVault.waitingMany: {{count}} ideas waiting here. Life doesn’t unlock this.

export.label: Export
export.pdfSavedWithAudio: PDF saved. Audio files downloaded separately.
export.hint: PDF: text & sketches. Audio files separately (don’t fit in the PDF).

sparkExpiry.mailed: {{count}} expired spark sent to {{email}} and deleted.
sparkExpiry.mailed_plural: {{count}} expired sparks sent to {{email}} and deleted.
sparkExpiry.mailFailed: Sparks are older than 7 days — send failed. They stay until sending works (or you delete them).
sparkExpiry.purged: {{count}} spark older than {{days}} days removed. With an email in Settings they’re sent first.
sparkExpiry.purged_plural: {{count}} sparks older than {{days}} days removed. With an email in Settings they’re sent first.

language.label: App language
language.hint: Buddy, settings and prompts follow this language. Marketing pages stay German for now.
